title: Fast, never-stuck uploads
changes: Uploads the newest screenshot first and four at a time, so a slow connection no longer builds a backlog that grows forever.
Drops screenshots that are more than 15 seconds old or beyond the 5 newest: for live advice an old screen only delays the new ones.
New "Clear pending uploads" button, and a "Dropped (stale)" counter beside Pending.
Skips screenshots that have not visibly changed (a blinking cursor does not count), but still sends one every 10 seconds so the server knows the feed is alive.
Folders are dated by the day the screenshot was taken, not the day it was uploaded.
Each upload carries timing data (queue, capture and upload time) for the server's Timing page.
The window title shows the version.

title: Earlier release
changes: Screenshot capture every few seconds with upload to the cloud; installer and portable .exe.
